name: ROMEO Phase Unwrapping
summary: Performs phase offset removal, phase unwrapping, phase quality mapping, robust masking, T2* and R2* mapping, and B0 field mapping.
description: Processes multi-echo gradient-echo magnitude and phase images with the ROMEO algorithm from the Julia MriResearchTools library: MCPC-3D-S phase offset removal, phase unwrapping, a voxel-wise phase quality map, phase-based masking, T2*/R2* fitting and a B0 field map. Use it as a preprocessing step for QSM or field mapping. main downloads Julia 1.9.3 and installs the Julia packages at run time instead of using a container, so the compute resource needs internet access.

inputs.description: Multi-echo T2*-weighted magnitude images (one NIfTI per echo).
Multi-echo T2*-weighted phase images (one NIfTI per echo).
inputs.requirements: Echoes must match the magnitude images in number and order.
